description: Planted git fixtures for A1 (audit/tamper.py), one per finding kind plus a clean one (S05 §4.3, task 7108). Each is the base repo below, made a task repo with its pristine bundle, then changed and archived the way the driver archives an agent's final tree (archive.commit_final, archive.archive_task), so A1 reads it from a real <stem>.bundle. A planted change starts from the honest solution unless it sets "solution": false; then it applies, in this order, rename (old path -> new path), delete, write (path -> text) and replace (path -> [[old text, new text], ...], each old text exactly once). The manifest's visible_test_hashes are computed from the base's visible test directories when the fixture is built. These are data, not files on disk, so pytest never collects the planted tests.

base..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: sh tests/visible/run.sh
